interactives.label: Rules of the canyon
interactives.text: One party at a time. The pride comes to you; the wash behind stays quiet once you have cleared it. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The riders' seep
interactives.text: The only water in the canyon. The riders' horses found it first; the lions found the horses.

interactives.label: Duskmane's spoils
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
